🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Stadt (Around the city)

der Platz = square
das Rathaus = town hall
die Post = post office
die Bank = bank
die Apotheke = pharmacy
das Krankenhaus = hospital

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
